definitions.short: properly, wrestled ; but used (in the plural) transitively, a struggle
definitions.full: H5319. naphtulim [ נַפְתּוּלִים ] noun [masculine] plural wrestlings (compare √ Niph`al Perfect ); — construct א ׳נַפְתּוּלֵי Gen 30:8 wrestlings of God , i.e. mighty wrestlings.

occurrences.englishText: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.
